title: 3 feet floodwater over Ghungi Nala, Birmaharajpur–Charmal road cut off - ODISHA RAY
article_text:
Birmaharjpur: Transportation on the Birmaharajpur–Charmal road has been disrupted after floodwater started flowing over Ghungi Nala near Luturpank in Subarnapur district of Odisha.

Due to heavy overnight rainfall in upstream areas, around 3 feet of floodwater is flowing over the bridge.
The overflow has made it unsafe for vehicles to pass.

Local administration has advised commuters to avoid the route and use alternate roads. Officials are monitoring the situation.
